  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 (high) — .inputs/academy/src/features/labs/desktop/use-desktop-draft.ts:98,159 and saveOnce's completion handlers: the shared device queue orders operations already enqueued, but an old view's remote completion can enqueue a new stale operation after a newer view's work. Independently reproduced both cases: view 1 starts remote A, closes, view 2 keeps C and closes; a late failure from view 1 writes its older B over C, while a late successful A acknowledgement clears C entirely. The prior held-device-acknowledgement case is fixed, but remote completion still violates the same lifetime requirement. Bind device writes/clears to current per-attempt work ownership/version, so retired views cannot mutate a newer view's copy. Acceptance: delayed remote failure and success after the newer view saves and closes both preserve C across reopening, with no automatic resend.",
    "R2 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/offline_domain.rs:1049: a download's final update checks only stamp(current), ignoring the newer validated stamp written by revalidation. An older download can start while access is allowed, wait for its bundle, then finish after a newer revalidation persisted withdrawal. The course retains its older observed stamp, so the download overwrites the newer denial with status=current and becomes readable again. Reject a download superseded by any later authority observation, including revalidation, and preserve the newer denial. Acceptance: delay an already-authorized download response, complete a newer access denial, release the download, then verify the course and its attempts remain locked offline and after restart.",
    "R3 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/offline_domain.rs:687,703; authority/learner_domain.rs:1210; the draft hook's syncDevice: confirm_draft silently ignores a missing attempt record and all store.update failures, yet the mutation is still returned as successful and the hook clears the local draft. At the account byte limit, an existing local draft can fit while growing the cached attempt to contain the same draft returns Full; clearing then deletes the only up-to-date offline copy. The positive save/restart test covers only a successful cache write. Make local-copy deletion conditional on verified durable offline continuity, retaining the copy when confirmation persistence is unavailable, full or unconfirmed. Acceptance: inject Full, interrupted/unavailable commit and missing-cache cases after a successful hosted save/resolve; the newest work survives offline restart without extending its content lease or replaying a mutation.",
    "R4 (medium) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/offline_domain.rs:703,729: confirm_draft and keep_newer_draft replace draft/version while retaining old result/conflict projections. Academy's visibleResults normally marks graded steps stale when their draft changes, but the offline path can pair version-3 answers with a version-2 passing step verdict. A stale attempt read can also restore conflicts already cleared by a confirmed resolve, because keep_newer_draft preserves only the newer draft/version. Keep the cached projection consistent when advancing learner work: invalidate or explicitly qualify draft-dependent verdicts and preserve resolved conflict state against older replies. Acceptance: edit a previously checked step, confirm the new draft and reopen offline without readback; the old pass is not presented as checking the new work. A delayed pre-resolution attempt reply must not resurrect the resolved conflict.",
    "R5 (medium) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/offline_domain.rs:292,894,966: observation ordering depends on wall-clock nanoseconds, but a new OfflineGen starts its counter at zero instead of advancing beyond persisted stamps. After restart with the clock corrected backwards, fresh hosted locks/withdrawals can be rejected until wall time catches up. A course downloaded earlier can still have a valid lease and download time while its latest validation stamp lies ahead of the corrected clock, so this can ignore a real access denial rather than merely lock content. Make request ordering independent of wall-clock rollback across generations/restarts while preserving lease-clock checks. Acceptance: seed future persisted observation/validation stamps, restart at an earlier clock still after the download time, and prove fresh hosted denials and renewals apply in request order without waiting for wall time to catch up."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [],
  "optional_suggestions": [
    "Downloads shows only a count of local drafts and says to open their labs. Consider listing recognizable lab/course labels and direct reopening actions so learners can find saved work without remembering its location."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Independently verified all four supplied fingerprints, the 321-entry source inventory, all 114 packet references, run/log/artifact hashes, installed shared-package inputs, pinned Academy 50fbf437569326a404ab3430d129a9c922dd133c tree and the passing C06 attempt-05 predecessor receipt. Rechecked frozen inputs before writing this verdict.",
    "Several attempt-02 findings are resolved in their demonstrated cases: authorization now reads stored records; rebuilds are serialized; withdrawal is published before unrelated attempt checks; key verification prevents wrong-key recovery/pruning; local loads join opening and unreadable copies are preserved; successful confirmation advances cached learner work without changing its lease. Recorded tests cover same-revision re-download versus older revalidation and newer locks versus delayed attempt replies.",
    "E1 is resolved: the native oversized parts now use the complete bundle projection, validate their serialized size below Academy's 7 MiB cap, and the source-bound native record shows fetching stopped after three parts with no download retained. The interrupted-write library test and new wrong-key preservation test both execute in the common gate.",
    "Independently ran six in-memory React/JSDOM checks against the actual pinned draft hook. Original failed-save/latest-edit recovery, delayed device load after confirmation, the prior cross-mount device-acknowledgement case and unreadable-copy preservation pass. Late remote failure and late remote success after a newer view closes respectively overwrite and delete its newer unsent work. These use scripted mutation/device boundaries, not a native window.",
    "Rust findings concerning a late download after revocation, ignored confirmation-persistence failures, inconsistent draft-dependent projections and persisted clock ordering are source-path/interleaving analyses. Did not run filesystem-writing Rust tests or alter the system clock; this review allows writes only to its verdict. Inspected the actual new tests and their source-bound execution records.",
    "Submitted gates report 203 desktop tests, 58 core unit tests, 1360 shared presentation tests, 26 C07 integration tests, 120 selected frontend tests, the truth-graph gate and 46 guarded mutation probes with six passing baselines. These establish the covered remediations, not the remaining cases above.",
    "All 65 submitted C07/C01/C04/C05/C06 native checks report pass on executable 8cb6c334621fa6d7f5f22ff46ffd8db44847f682c9aecb967776f5108add1605. Inspected native fixture changes, request/storage observations and relevant AX records. Native interaction was not repeated; native Keychain denial, spoken VoiceOver and hosted Academy qualification remain outside these synthetic flows.",
    "The Academy pin is locally committed and the packet reports its branch remains unpushed because of pre-push content-suite RPC timeouts. Fresh remote retrieval was not established. No application source was changed, no product endpoint was called and no real credential was accessed. This verdict covers C07 only; hosted qualification remains C25 and signed installed-package qualification remains C26."
  ],
